title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26
lineage: PCM > Sony PCM601esd (spdif out) > VX Pocket/Laptop > Nuendo > Waves q10 > WAV 16/44

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording with a bright high‑end tilt, capturing a laid‑back California summer show highlighted by a monster "The Other One" and stellar Sugar Magnolia
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its vocal mix, energetic "The Other One", tight Phil zone bass, and a lively Keith jam, embodying the relaxed yet vibrant vibe of the 1973 stadium shows. The soundboard source sounds generally clear but leans heavy on the high end, suggesting the emphasis settings may be off.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout moments outweighs a modest recording imbalance (excessive high‑end), leading to an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High‑end frequencies are pronounced compared to other releases; vocal mix is praised, but the emphasis may be a bit off.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Laid‑back California vibe with strong second‑set energy; vocal mix and instrumental jams keep the momentum flowing.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil zone noted, indicating powerful bass presence
band_member_comments.Keys: "Go Keith go" jam highlighted keyboard work
